title: Crystalline sulfur-doped poly(heptazine imide) for enhanced photocatalytic H2 evolution under visible-light irradiation
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,2327-2332
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01777C, Paper
Cheng Cheng, Wenze Luo, Binjiang Zhai, Li Tian, Jinwen Shi, Zhifu Zhou, Fei Chen, Xiangjiu Guan
A highly crystalline sulfur-doped PHI (S-PHI) is synthesized from the compound 1H-1,2,4-triazole-3-thiol. S-PHI exhibits enhanced light utilization, enlarged surface area and promoted charge-carrier transfer efficiency as compared to PHI.
